title: Florida House, District 48
what_it_does: Represents District 48 in the Florida House of Representatives; votes on state laws and the state budget.
decided_note: Incumbent Republican Jon Albert defeated Jerry Carter in the Aug. 18, 2026 Republican primary. A closed party primary was held Aug. 18, 2026, which under Florida law means at least one other candidate (opposing-party, no-party or write-in) qualified for the Nov. 3 general election; that opponent's name could not be verified from search snippets.
verified_ballot_note: Brownstein/Rubin Turnbull's post-primary report and Ballotpedia record that Jon Albert (incumbent) defeated Jerry Carter in the HD 48 Republican primary (https://www.bhfs.com/insight/florida-2026-post-primary-election-report/; https://ballotpedia.org/Jon_Albert). The November opponent's name was not found. Research limitation: every WebFetch (Ballotpedia, Wikipedia, Division of Elections, county SOEs, news sites) was blocked and the search budget was capped, so this roster comes only from search-result snippets and should be re-verified against the county Supervisor of Elections sample ballot.
